original_test_intent: Prove a provisioned AST1060/PFR detects an intentionally invalid BMC active region, restores it from the approved recovery source, verifies the recovered firmware and returns BMC services to the expected healthy version/state.
original_method: Map exact SPI device/active/recovery regions and PFR lifecycle; back up full flash and configuration; verify DediProg adapter, voltage, image/hash and bad-active construction; qualified operator de-energizes/isolate-programs only the active target once; restore connections and stable power; capture AST1060 verification/recovery events and duration; confirm recovered hash/version, boot/services/network/SEL and immutable/non-target regions; retain external reflash rollback.
manual_activity: Qualified flash-programmer operator performs the authorized offline active-region corruption; agent may collect and validate PFR recovery and BMC health evidence.
required_inputs: AST1060/PFR firmware, provision/lock state and recovery architecture
Exact SPI part, active/recovery address ranges and protected regions
Known-good/recovery/bad-active images, construction rules and hashes
DediProg model/adapter/voltage/procedure, full backup, stable power, console and rollback
safety_requirements: Verify chip/region/voltage and full backup before one offline write
Use stable controlled power and independent console/programmer access
Stop on verify mismatch or unexpected region change; never cycle power mid-recovery or retry automatically
agent_execution_scope: Validate supplied manifests/backups and collect pre/post flash/PFR/BMC evidence
Monitor recovery events, timing, version/services and region hashes after operator action
Do not corrupt/program hardware, infer target, erase whole flash, interrupt recovery, retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve exact target region and bad-image construction
Approve programmer/electrical procedure, backup and external rollback
Review evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Post-recovery `mc info` is useful but cannot prove which region was restored, PFR verification or non-target integrity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Combine operator/programmer verify logs with AST1060 event/measurement evidence, recovered region hash and full BMC service health.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Provision check, active-region destruction, DediProg programming, AST1060 recovery, verify and boot remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an address-bounded offline corruption with full backup and traceable recovery measurements, then prove recovered content and services.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact flash map, image provenance, non-target integrity, stable-power timing and external rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A booting BMC or unchanged version string does not prove AST1060 recovered the intended region rather than booting an alternate path.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong chip/range/voltage can destroy trust or recovery data; PFR recovery may take time and interruption can require complete external reflash.

project_override_considerations: If a vendor fault-injection interface can corrupt only the active region while preserving the same recovery path, engineering may approve it; otherwise preserve the DediProg physical coverage.
expected_evidence: Offline write/verify log proving only approved active range changed
Recovered hash/version, boot/services/network/SEL, non-target integrity and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently cover destructive bad-active-region injection followed by AST1060 verify/recovery and BMC boot.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2279 Wistron-HW-00246-V003: approve AST1060/PFR firmware and lifecycle, exact BMC SPI part plus active/recovery/provisioning address map, bad-active image construction/hash and expected recovery source/content/version; DediProg model/adapter/voltage/offline write/verify procedure, full backup and protected non-target regions; define recovery event/signature, maximum duration, stable-power policy, recovered hash/boot/service/SEL oracle and external reflash rollback.

review_improvement: Preserves deliberate active-region failure coverage while ensuring the destructive write is bounded and recovery is proven by content and event evidence, not just a version string.
independent_technical_reasoning: PFR recovery depends on exact flash-region ownership and trust state. Programming the wrong offset can overwrite recovery or provisioning data and eliminate the mechanism under test. A BMC may also boot from an alternate bank without restoring the corrupted bytes. Therefore the test must prove address-bounded corruption, AST1060 detection and recovery events, recovered region hash and unchanged protected regions, with stable power and external programmer rollback throughout.
